scope: Visual review of the final 1600x1000, 96-sample images; separate from user acceptance or survey fidelity.

images.notes: Four courts follow Y, divider crosses precinct, bridge connections clear; inherited garden voids closed and southern water surfaces continuous.
Ground view verifies transverse sagging net, singles/doubles markings, enclosure and horizontal divider; no visible void or obstruction.
Reverse elevated view confirms northern gate, three-way landing, island bridge and utility-side path. Off-site background remains outside modeled scope.
Recessed frames, dark gaskets, latches and glazing reflections visible; pale facade retains edge shading.
Condenser concentric wire guard, radial supports, radiator fins and mounting feet align with original casing; facade seams and latches remain visible.
Contoured seat pans and backs, rolled front edges and blue/white plastic surface shading reviewed at close range.
Source-backed name wall and relief remain intact; front plaza, gate and refined facade visible under balanced daylight.
Central stair, metal railings, continuous timber grain, display recesses and polished floor reviewed; circulation remains unobstructed.

Groundcover, foliage light response, water and path continuity inspected. Existing procedural trunk/canopy silhouettes remain visibly simplified at close range; this pass does not claim photographic vegetation fidelity.
Separate upholstered cushions, smoothed rounded arms/base and lowered leaning mustard pillows reviewed; previous suspended-pillow appearance corrected.
Concave blue stools and rolled rims visible, support frames align, tabletops rounded and aisle flooring continuous.

Original exhibit panels and miniature window detail retained. Cabinet verified as separate 20–26 mm glass panels; overhead-light glare is strong at this oblique view and reduces miniature readability.
Upper hall wood flooring, court markings, basket structures, roof trusses and gallery stairs reviewed under final lighting.

Integrated overview confirms retained main-campus families, eight basketball courts and rotated four-court tennis precinct. Context outside modeled campus is omitted; survey accuracy remains unverified.
